q: How many days of annual leave does a GL 08 officer get?
fact: 30 working days for GL 07 and above

q: How long must I wait after my last annual leave before I can go on leave again?
fact: not less than six months after the previous leave

q: How many days of casual leave can I take in a year?
fact: maximum of seven days

q: How much maternity leave can a female officer take?
fact: 112 working days with full pay

q: Do male officers get leave when their wife gives birth?
fact: 14 working days, once in two years, max four children

q: What is study leave and who can get it?
fact: granted to a confirmed serving officer

q: What should I do if I am sick and cannot come to work?
fact: notify Ministry/Agency; prolonged absence needs supporting documents

q: What happens if I'm given a query?
fact: written details of unsatisfactory behaviour; submit written representation within a specific time

q: My supervisor wants to interdict me. What does that mean?
fact: interdiction definition and conditions

q: What is the difference between suspension and interdiction?
fact: suspension is not a synonym for interdiction

q: What are examples of serious misconduct?
fact: falsification of records, suppression of records, absence without leave, etc.

q: Can I do private business while in the civil service?
fact: no private practice, exemptions for medical practitioners, law lecturers, ICT and agric business

q: Can a civil servant buy shares or be a company director?
fact: may hold shares; not director of private companies

q: Can I join a political party or contest an election?
fact: no political office or candidacy without express permission of Government

q: Can I accept gifts from people I serve?
fact: no gifts in recognition or anticipation of service

q: What is the retirement age in the civil service?
fact: 60 years or 35 years of pensionable service, whichever is earlier

q: What do I lose if I resign?
fact: forfeit claims to vacation leave; refund money owed

q: How long is probation for a new officer?
fact: two years

q: What do I need to be confirmed in my appointment?
fact: eligibility conditions for confirmation

q: Does acting in a post mean I will be promoted?
fact: acting appointment is not a means of testing suitability for promotion

q: What is the difference between transfer and secondment?
fact: transfer is permanent release

q: Who is entitled to overtime allowance?
fact: officers on GL 14 and below

q: What is duty tour allowance for?
fact: to pay for lodging and feeding on official travel

q: What happens to my entitlements if I die in service?
fact: life insurance entitlements paid to legal representative / next of kin

q: How can I send a petition to the Head of Government?
fact: unsealed, in triplicate, through the proper channels

q: Can I use a big man to help my promotion?
fact: no seeking influence of prominent persons

q: Wetin go happen if I no come work for one week without permission?
fact: absence without leave: liable to dismissal (100413); listed as serious misconduct (100402)

q: What rules apply to virtual meetings?
fact: predefined agenda, protocols

q: If I am suspended and later cleared, do I get my salary back?
fact: reinstated with full salary denied if interdicted or suspended (Rule 100307(x))
